about: What the 3D model viewer loads. Paths are relative to public/models-web, which holds web-sized copies of the raw files in public/models (the raw files stay out of git: 176 MB). The copies keep the geometry and cap the textures (1024 px, 512 px for the city block, 2048 px for the rubble scan); the four Mixamo FBX files are merged into one GLB with all four clips on the one rig; the rubble OBJ is the same mesh with its numbers written to 0.1 mm instead of 17 digits. Each entry in characters is another rigged Mixamo character ({ id, label, file, source, size, at, mb }), stood beside the first and given the same four clips, retargeted onto its own bones.
